overviewParagraphs: Twin Doves Golf Club is widely regarded as one of the finest private clubs in southern Vietnam. Comprising the Luna, Stella, and Sole nines, the 27-hole complex provides a diverse test of golf in an idyllic setting just one hour from the bustling center of Ho Chi Minh City.

The Luna Course winds through gentle hills and mature forests, requiring pinpoint accuracy off the tee. The Stella Course demands a strategic approach, with natural creeks and lakes coming into play on almost every hole. Finally, the Sole Course offers a challenging links-style feel, characterized by strategic bunkering and island greens.

Beyond the immaculate course conditioning, Twin Doves is renowned for its exceptional facilities. The sweeping, contemporary clubhouse overlooks the 18th greens, providing an expansive space for post-round relaxation, a well-stocked pro shop, and world-class dining spanning Vietnamese, Korean, and Western cuisines.

curatorBriefHtml: Twin Doves Golf Club (opened 2011 in Binh Duong Province, roughly 60–70 minutes north of central Ho Chi Minh City) is Southern Vietnam’s premier private 27-hole members’ sanctuary. Designed by Peter Rousseau (P+Z Development), the club comprises three distinct 9-hole loops — Luna, Stella, and Sole (7,234 yards across championship 18-hole combinations, Par 72) — set across tranquil, manicured parkland with crisp lakeside views and a sleek glass-walled clubhouse.

Having played Twin Doves personally, what immediately distinguishes it from Saigon’s busier public clubs is calm, uncrowded exclusivity and consistently pristine Paspalum conditioning. Because Twin Doves operates as a private members’ club, fairways stay clean, greens roll smooth and true, and four-balls move at a relaxed country-club tempo.
AGS arranges curated visitor access at Twin Doves for discerning groups based in Ho Chi Minh City who want a quiet, polished private-club round alongside VGCC and Long Thanh.

scorecard.verdict: An upscale 27-hole private members' club in Binh Duong offering immaculate tournament conditioning and a seamless 5-star clubhouse environment.

faqs.q: Can non-members play the private Twin Doves Golf Club?
faqs.a: While Twin Doves operates as an exclusive private members’ club, Asia Golf Specialists holds direct partner access to arrange confirmed visitor tee times on weekdays and select weekends.

faqs.q: Which two 9-hole loops are best among Twin Doves' 27 holes?
faqs.a: The Luna and Stella loops deliver the most dramatic water hazards, bold bunkering, and manicured resort vistas, while the Sole nine offers scenic tree-lined precision holes.

faqs.q: How far is Twin Doves Golf Club from District 1, Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Plan for 60 to 75 minutes north of central Ho Chi Minh City in a private touring vehicle, departing around 07:00 AM to beat morning commuter traffic.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Twin Doves?
faqs.a: December through April offers dry, sunny Southern Vietnam weather; during May–November, morning tee times finish comfortably ahead of late-afternoon showers.
